actions.action: Retry only files without confirmed acceptance
actions.mechanism: Receipt-backed acceptance survives later network errors; uncertain uploads are reconciled before another upload starts.
actions.implementation: Show per-file states: uploading, accepted, failed, or checking. Add upload-attempt status lookup; retry confirmed failures only, retaining accepted receipts.
actions.check: Interrupt responses after server acceptance. Verify reconciliation finds receipts and retry sends no accepted file bytes.
actions.risk: Unresolved status must stay visibly uncertain, not silently become failed.

actions.mechanism: Short-lived receipt storage restores server-held attachments without retaining file content or relying on an account.
actions.implementation: Store only opaque receipts with 24-hour expiry. On reopening, resolve them server-side, list available attachments, and explain that unconfirmed files require reselection.
actions.check: Close after partial acceptance and reopen. Verify accepted attachments return, reselection guidance appears, and browser storage contains no file content.
actions.risk: Expired or unavailable receipts require explicit explanation; shared-device recovery can expose attachment metadata.

actions.action: Make replacement an explicit attachment decision
actions.mechanism: Five visible attachment slots distinguish retrying a failure from adding or replacing an attachment.
actions.implementation: Count accepted, uploading, and uncertain files toward five. Require explicit removal or replacement before admitting another; cancel or reconcile pending attempts first.
actions.check: With four accepted files and one uncertain upload, attempt a sixth. Verify it is blocked until a slot is resolved.
actions.risk: Removing an attachment from the list must not imply server deletion.

actions.action: Review once and submit without duplicate cases
actions.mechanism: Explicit review gates case creation; server-side idempotency makes uncertain submission outcomes recoverable without creating another case.
actions.implementation: Show the final receipt-backed list and require confirmation. Bind a submission token to that reviewed version; recover its outcome through receipt lookup.
actions.check: Change the list after review, double-click submit, then disconnect and reopen. Require renewed review and verify only one case exists.
actions.risk: Attachment or form edits must invalidate review; disable submission while uploads remain unresolved.
